newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai exchange to expand off-floor trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai exchange to expand off-floor trading.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange will formally expand off-floor trading from next week following more than two months of trial operations, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The exchange has said it wants off-floor trading through computer networks to become the primary means of trading on the exchange, thereby expanding its business throughout China.
The newspaper described the shift away from floor trading as being the most important development in the Shanghai exchange since it was set up in 1990.
It said that firms trading on the exchange would no longer have to have representatives on the exchange trading floor.

The Shanghai exchange has been under pressure from brokers in recent months to take measures to improve business and liquidity in the face of a growing challenge from China's other stock exchange in the southern city of Shenzhen.
